description: Diagnostic curves of the final model of run main/fable51 (round_56) for the statistics, state reconstruction and bivariate event panels of the paper figure. Event counts, forecast correlations, observed events and the reconstructed-variable targets are read from scores/fable51_final_event_counts.csv, scores/fable51_final_forecast_correlation.csv, grader_obs/obs_bivariate_events.npz and grader_obs/indices_truth.nc.

statistics.band: mean plus and minus one standard deviation across 70-year segments of the free run

assimilation.band: ensemble mean plus and minus two ensemble standard deviations
